tasks.label: Setup: create .venv and install requirements
tasks.command: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

windows.command: python -m venv .venv; .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install --upgrade pip; .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
